# GitHub Actions included

- `snake.yml` → contribution snake, daily + manual.
- `pacman.yml` → Pac-Man + arcade contribution games, daily + manual.
- `profile-3d.yml` → 3D contribution calendar, daily + manual.
- `spotify.yml` → current listening / queue / recent history / top signal, every 10 minutes + manual.

All workflows are configured for `itsprathi/itsprathi`.

The package intentionally does not push anything to GitHub; it is a ready-to-copy profile kit.
